status: Draft rules. Actions and escalation steps must be validated against NDRRMC/PAGASA guidance and the Mogpog MDRRMO before real use.

exposureTypes.label: Near a river
exposureTypes.note: Rivers can rise quickly. Stay away from riverbanks and do not cross swollen rivers.

exposureTypes.label: Coastal area
exposureTypes.note: Strong winds and rough seas can affect shorelines. Stay away from the coast.

exposureTypes.label: Low-lying or flood-prone area
exposureTypes.note: Floodwater collects in low areas. Plan to move early.

exposureTypes.label: Upland or slope area
exposureTypes.note: Heavy rain can trigger landslides. Watch for cracks in the ground and leaning trees.

0.label: Stay informed
steps: Check PAGASA and local government announcements regularly.
Review your go-bag checklist and emergency contacts.

1.label: Prepare
steps: Prepare your go-bag and important documents.
Know your nearest evacuation center and route.

2.label: Be ready to evacuate
steps: Keep your go-bag by the door.
Put documents and medicines in a waterproof bag.
Agree on a family meeting point.
Move vehicles and livestock to higher ground if you can.
Be ready to leave as soon as officials announce it.

3.label: Evacuate
steps: Go to your designated evacuation center now.
Follow instructions from barangay officials and responders.
Bring your go-bag, medicines and IDs.
Check on neighbors who may need help: elderly, children, persons with disabilities.
